payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of ecommerce support specialists for customer Lila Moreno regarding delivered order #. The customer provided two cracked-screen photos of the espresso machine, a document of the packing slip, and a screenshot of a chat where a prior agent mentioned a possible goodwill credit. Reference entity IDs: customer id, order id #. MANDATORY steps: 1. identity_verifier must authenticate Lila Moreno by email before any account-specific action, 2. order_specialist must inspect the delivered order confirm the damaged item from the provided evidence and order record, and determine the valid post-delivery path, 3. refund_specialist must calculate the allowed financial outcome and distinguish policy-based refund from any optional goodwill amount, 4. case_analyst must review the scoped case history for prior promises or conflicting notes, 5. commerce_ops_manager must synthesize the team result and provide a concise final resolution summary without exposing raw PII.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- packing slip order EC 44172: Provided packing slip for the delivered package, containing precise order and shipment details used to compare against the order record. Extracted content: Ship To Packing Slip Order Ec-44172 Provided packing slip for the delivered package, containing precise order and shipment details used to compare against the order record. Details Document Title Packing Slip Order Id EC-44172 Customer Name Lila Moreno Customer Id CUS-6178 Ship To Name Lila Moreno Shipping Method Standard Ground Carrier UPS Tracking Number 1Z84A56E0392457812 Item Listed espresso machine Quantity 1 Package Count 1 of 1 Delivery Status Delivered Additional Information a realistic 1-page ecommerce packing slip document in a clean warehouse/fulfillment style a header block with merchant information on the left and order identifiers on the right the order number and customer ID prominently a compact line-item table with columns such as SKU, item description, quantity, and condition/notes Use black text on white background, simple rules/dividers, barcode-style visual elements near the order or tracking area, and realistic spacing consistent with a printed packing slip inserted into a shipped box This summary is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
